name: IFERROR
description: IFERROR returns a custom result when a formula generates an error, and the formula result otherwise.
tldr: IFERROR catches errors and returns a custom value instead.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The formula to check for errors.

parameters.name: value_if_error
parameters.description: The value to return if the formula results in an error.

basicExample.explanation: Returns "Cannot divide by zero" when B1 is 0.

advancedExamples.title: Handle VLOOKUP errors
advancedExamples.description: Show friendly message when VLOOKUP fails

howItWorks: IFERROR evaluates the first argument. If it results in any error (#N/A, #VALUE!, #REF!, etc.), it returns the second argument.

howToSteps.name: Wrap with IFERROR
howToSteps.text: Wrap it with IFERROR and provide a fallback value.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the formula output or fallback.

limitations: For catching only #N/A errors, use IFNA instead.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: IFERROR works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What is the difference between IFERROR and IFNA?
faq.answer: IFERROR catches all errors; IFNA only catches #N/A errors.
